name: Santiago-Rosalía de Castro Airport
before:
Galicia's main airport, and the busiest in the north west of Spain after Bilbao. It handled 3.6 million passengers in 2024 and sits 12 km east of Santiago de Compostela, in the parish of Lavacolla. The Camino de Santiago runs close by.

Everything works from one terminal, opened in October 2011 and covering 74,000 square metres, which replaced a 1969 building next door on the same site.

The route map is worth watching rather than assuming. Vueling treats the airport as a focus city for the north west of the peninsula, and in July 2026 Wizz Air announced it would open a base here in December 2026, its first in the Galicia and north Portugal region. That is a meaningful amount of new capacity for an airport this size, so check current schedules rather than working from last season.

It took the name of the Galician poet Rosalía de Castro in 2020 and is still widely listed as Santiago de Compostela.
after:
Galicia's busiest airport, 12 km east of Santiago de Compostela at Lavacolla. It handled about 3.1 million passengers in 2025, 14 per cent fewer than in 2024.

Everything works from one terminal, opened in October 2011 to replace the 1969 building.

The route map is worth watching rather than assuming. In July 2026 Wizz Air announced a base here: it says one aircraft will be based at the airport from 1 February 2027, with seven new routes. That is a meaningful amount of new capacity for an airport this size, so check current schedules rather than working from last season.

It took the name of the Galician writer Rosalía de Castro in 2020 and is still widely listed as Santiago de Compostela.

claims.note: Was 'Galicia's main airport, and the busiest in the north west of Spain after Bilbao'. Aena's 2025 figures put Santiago well ahead of Galicia's other airports (A Coruña 1,292,166, Vigo 1,114,810); Eurostat agrees. The Bilbao comparison is cut: Wikipedia says 'second busiest in northern Spain after Bilbao', which the old text turned into 'north west', and Bilbao is not in the north west.
